regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (calendar has no regional titles and no locator map)
regions.notes: Lean box drawn in two pieces (Nov-Dec and Jan-Feb), recorded as one Nov-Feb season. Staple/cotton planting continues into the first half of Jan. Winter wheat is planted May-Jun and harvested Sep-Oct, outside the rainy season. Tobacco planting starts in Sep, before the rains, so it is not linked to the rainy season. Green harvest (mid-Feb to Mar), vegetables and labour bars not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Planting: staple food crops, cotton (Jan 49%).

assign.method: Single national calendar with no regional titles; every province mapped to 'national'.

transcriber_notes: Staple planting ends exactly mid-Jan (counted as Jan).
